dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An isosceles-like triangular arrangement formed by the centroids of three large macro-annuli in the upper-central dorsal area, with a secondary linear chain of four small blobs extending posteriorly from the triangle's base.
